description: This file defines a settings activity for a voice recognition service, allowing configuration of preferences such as the type of recognition results (letters or numbers). It uses Android's PreferenceActivity and manages shared preferences.

classes.name: VoiceRecognitionSettings
classes.description: An activity that allows users to configure voice recognition preferences such as result type.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the preference activity, sets the shared preferences file, and loads preferences from a resource.
